statement.zh: 阿拜多斯圣区及相关发掘（与《王陵》卷互补）见 Petrie《阿拜多斯》I（EEF Memoir 22，1902）。
statement.en: At Abydos, temenos-area and related excavations complementary to the Royal Tombs volumes are documented in Petrie Abydos Part I (EEF Memoir 22, 1902).
